import builtins
f = builtins.cl_fails
c = app.clips.new('wave', duration=1.0)
assert c == {'name': 'wave', 'duration': 1.0, 'loop': False, 'tracks': []}, c
f('clip.new', "a clip named 'wave' exists", name='wave')
f('clip.new', 'duration must be above 0 s', name='x', duration=0.0)
f('clip.play', "clip 'wave' has no keys")
app.actions.run('robot.set_targets', targets={'shoulder_yaw': 0.0, 'shoulder_pitch': 0.3, 'elbow': -1.0})
assert app.clips.list()['clips'][0]['keys'] == 0
r = app.clips.key_pose(0.0, source='target')
assert r == {'clip': 'wave', 'time': 0.0, 'set': 3}, r
r = app.clips.key(keys=[{'joint': 'shoulder_yaw', 'time': 1.0, 'value': 0.8}, {'joint': 'shoulder_pitch', 'time': 1.0, 'value': -0.4},
                        {'joint': 'elbow', 'time': 1.0, 'value': -0.2}])
assert r == {'clip': 'wave', 'set': 3, 'keys': 6}, r
f('clip.key', "no joint 'nope'", joint='nope', time=0.5, value=0.0)
f('clip.key', 'time: 0 to 1 s', joint='elbow', time=1.5, value=0.0)
f('clip.key', 'interp: step, linear or bezier', joint='elbow', time=0.5, value=0.0, interp='cubic')
f('clip.key_pose', "no pose 'nope'", pose='nope')
f('clip.key_pose', 'from: q or target', **{'from': 'x'})
assert app.clips.list()['clips'][0]['keys'] == 6
builtins.cl_check([0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.9, 1.0, 1.2])
s = app.clips.sample(0.25)['values']
print('CLIP_LINEAR', s)
assert abs(s['elbow'] + 0.8) < 1e-6 and abs(s['shoulder_yaw'] - 0.2) < 1e-6 and abs(s['shoulder_pitch'] - 0.125) < 1e-6, s

import builtins
f, check, tracks = builtins.cl_fails, builtins.cl_check, builtins.cl_tracks
lin = app.clips.sample(0.5)['values']['elbow']
app.clips.key('elbow', 0.0, -1.0, interp='bezier', slope_out=4.0)
app.clips.key('elbow', 1.0, -0.2, interp='bezier', slope_in=-2.0)
k = tracks()['elbow']
assert [x['interp'] for x in k] == ['bezier', 'bezier'] and k[0]['out'] == 4.0 and k[1]['in'] == -2.0, k
bez = app.clips.sample(0.5)['values']['elbow']
want = 0.125 * -1.0 + 0.375 * (-1.0 + 4.0 / 3.0) + 0.375 * (-0.2 + 2.0 / 3.0) + 0.125 * -0.2
print('CLIP_BEZIER', lin, bez, want)
assert abs(bez - want) < 1e-5 and abs(bez - lin) > 0.5, (bez, lin, want)
check([0.1, 0.33, 0.5, 0.77])
app.clips.key('shoulder_pitch', 0.0, 0.3, interp='step')
check([0.2, 0.6, 0.999])
assert abs(app.clips.sample(0.999)['values']['shoulder_pitch'] - 0.3) < 1e-6
s = app.clips.list()
assert s['can_undo'] and not s['can_redo'], s
app.clips.undo()
assert tracks()['shoulder_pitch'][0]['interp'] == 'linear'
app.clips.undo()
app.clips.undo()
assert abs(app.clips.sample(0.5)['values']['elbow'] - lin) < 1e-6
app.clips.redo()
s = app.clips.redo()
assert s['can_undo'] and s['can_redo'], s
assert abs(app.clips.sample(0.5)['values']['elbow'] - bez) < 1e-6
s = app.clips.redo()
assert not s['can_redo'] and tracks()['shoulder_pitch'][0]['interp'] == 'step', s
f('clip.redo', '')

import builtins
f, check, tracks = builtins.cl_fails, builtins.cl_check, builtins.cl_tracks
r = app.clips.move_keys(dt=-0.5, keys=[{'joint': 'shoulder_yaw', 'time': 1.0}])
assert r == {'keys': [{'joint': 'shoulder_yaw', 'time': 0.5}]}, r
k = tracks()['shoulder_yaw']
assert [x['time'] for x in k] == [0.0, 0.5] and abs(k[1]['value'] - 0.8) < 1e-6, k
check([0.25, 0.75])
assert abs(app.clips.sample(0.75)['values']['shoulder_yaw'] - 0.8) < 1e-6
r = app.clips.move_keys(dt=0.75, dv=0.1, keys=[{'joint': 'shoulder_yaw', 'time': 0.5}])
k = tracks()['shoulder_yaw']
assert r['keys'][0]['time'] == 1.0 and k[1]['time'] == 1.0 and abs(k[1]['value'] - 0.9) < 1e-6, (r, k)
f('clip.move_keys', 'named twice', dt=0.1, keys=[{'joint': 'elbow', 'time': 0.0}, {'joint': 'elbow', 'time': 0.0}])
f('clip.move_keys', 'not on the clip', dt=0.1, keys=[{'joint': 'elbow', 'time': 0.3}])
f('clip.move_keys', 'no keys to move', dt=0.1)
app.clips.undo()
app.clips.undo()
k = tracks()['shoulder_yaw']
assert [x['time'] for x in k] == [0.0, 1.0] and abs(k[1]['value'] - 0.8) < 1e-6, k
s = app.clips.editor(selected=[{'joint': 'elbow', 'time': 1.0}, {'joint': 'shoulder_pitch', 'time': 1.0}])
assert len(s['selected']) == 2 and not s['open'], s
r = app.clips.move_keys(dv=-0.1)
assert len(r['keys']) == 2 and abs(tracks()['elbow'][1]['value'] + 0.3) < 1e-6, r
assert len(app.clips.list()['selected']) == 2
app.clips.undo()
r = app.clips.remove_keys()
assert r == {'removed': 2, 'keys': 4}, r
s = app.clips.list()
assert s['selected'] == [] and s['clips'][0]['keys'] == 4, s
assert abs(app.clips.sample(0.7)['values']['elbow'] + 1.0) < 1e-6
app.clips.undo()
r = app.clips.remove_keys(time=0.0)
assert r == {'removed': 3, 'keys': 3}, r
app.clips.undo()
r = app.clips.remove_keys(joint='shoulder_yaw')
assert r == {'removed': 2, 'keys': 4} and 'shoulder_yaw' not in tracks(), r
app.clips.undo()
f('clip.remove_keys', 'no key matches', joint='elbow', time=0.4)
assert app.clips.list()['clips'][0]['keys'] == 6 and sorted(tracks()) == ['elbow', 'shoulder_pitch', 'shoulder_yaw']
builtins.cl_check([0.0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0])

import builtins
dt = app.world.dt
rows = max(1, round(1.0 / dt))
builtins.cl_reset()
app.actions.run('robot.watch', on=True)
p = app.clips.play(play=False)
assert p == {'clip': 'wave', 'rows': rows, 'loop': False, 'env': 0}, p
builtins.cl_frames(3)
s = app.clips.list()
assert s['playing'] == 'wave' and s['left'] == rows and not s['loop'], s
n = rows // 2
builtins.cl_step(n)
s = app.clips.list()
print('CLIP_PLAY', rows, s['left'], s['playhead'])
assert s['playing'] == 'wave' and s['left'] == rows - n and abs(s['playhead'] - n * dt) < 1e-5, s
builtins.cl_step(rows - n + 200)
s = app.clips.list()
assert s['playing'] is None and s['left'] == 0 and abs(s['playhead'] - 1.0) < 1e-6, s
tr = builtins.cl_tracks()
for j, keys in tr.items():
    smp = app.actions.run('robot.samples', joint=j, count=rows + 200)
    assert smp['tick'] == list(range(1, rows + 201)), smp['tick'][:4]
    bad = [(t, v) for t, v in zip(smp['tick'], smp['target']) if abs(v - builtins.cl_ref(keys, min(min(t, rows) * dt, 1.0))) > 1e-5]
    assert not bad, (j, bad[:4])
q = {x['name']: x['q'] for x in app.actions.run('robot.joints')['joints']}
end = {j: k[-1]['value'] for j, k in tr.items()}
print('CLIP_END', q, end)
assert all(abs(q[j] - end[j]) < 0.05 for j in end), (q, end)
builtins.cl_rows = rows

import builtins
dt, rows = app.world.dt, builtins.cl_rows
builtins.cl_reset()
p = app.clips.play(loop=True, play=False)
assert p['loop'] and p['rows'] == rows, p
builtins.cl_step(rows + 30)
s = app.clips.list()
print('CLIP_LOOP', s['left'], s['playhead'])
assert s['playing'] == 'wave' and s['loop'] and s['left'] == rows - 30 and abs(s['playhead'] - 30 * dt) < 1e-5, s
keys = builtins.cl_tracks()['elbow']
smp = app.actions.run('robot.samples', joint='elbow', count=rows + 30)
assert smp['tick'] == list(range(1, rows + 31)), smp['tick'][:4]
bad = [(t, v) for t, v in zip(smp['tick'], smp['target']) if abs(v - builtins.cl_ref(keys, min(((t - 1) % rows + 1) * dt, 1.0))) > 1e-5]
assert not bad, bad[:4]
builtins.cl_step(rows // 3)

import builtins
f = builtins.cl_fails
f('clip.key', '', joint='elbow', time=0.5, value=0.0, clip='nope')
s = app.clips.stop()
assert s['playing'] is None and s['left'] == 0, s
builtins.cl_step(10)
assert app.clips.list()['playing'] is None
f('clip.stop', '')
app.actions.run('robot.watch', on=False)

import builtins
f, tracks = builtins.cl_fails, builtins.cl_tracks
s = app.clips.editor(auto_key=True, playhead=0.5, curve='elbow')
assert s['open'] and s['auto_key'] and s['playhead'] == 0.5 and s['curve'] == 'elbow', s
f('clip.editor', "no joint 'nope'", curve='nope')
f('clip.editor', 'interp: step, linear or bezier', interp='cubic')
n = app.clips.list()['clips'][0]['keys']
app.actions.run('robot.set_targets', targets={'elbow': -1.5})
builtins.cl_frames(2)
app.actions.run('robot.set_targets', targets={'elbow': -1.4, 'shoulder_yaw': 0.4})
k = tracks()
e = [x for x in k['elbow'] if x['time'] == 0.5]
assert len(e) == 1 and abs(e[0]['value'] + 1.4) < 1e-6 and e[0]['interp'] == 'linear', k['elbow']
assert app.clips.list()['clips'][0]['keys'] == n + 2
app.clips.undo()
assert app.clips.list()['clips'][0]['keys'] == n
app.clips.redo()
app.clips.editor(playhead=1.0)
app.actions.run('robot.set_targets', targets={'elbow': -0.3})
e = tracks()['elbow'][-1]
assert e['time'] == 1.0 and e['interp'] == 'bezier' and e['in'] == -2.0 and abs(e['value'] + 0.3) < 1e-6, e
app.clips.editor(playhead=0.25, selected=[{'joint': 'elbow', 'time': 0.5}])

app.clips.editor(auto_key=False)
n = app.clips.list()['clips'][0]['keys']
app.actions.run('robot.set_targets', targets={'elbow': -0.6})
assert app.clips.list()['clips'][0]['keys'] == n

import builtins, json
f, tracks = builtins.cl_fails, builtins.cl_tracks
before = app.clips.get()
r = app.clips.save('${out}/wave.nkclip.json')
assert r == {'path': '${out}/wave.nkclip.json', 'clip': 'wave'}, r
with open('${out}/wave.nkclip.json') as h:
    d = json.load(h)
assert d['format'] == 'nkclip' and d['version'] == 1 and d['clip'] == before, d
d['clip']['name'] = 'wave2'
d['clip']['tracks'][0]['keys'][0]['value'] = 0.25
with open('${out}/wave2.nkclip.json', 'w') as h:
    json.dump(d, h)
r = app.clips.load('${out}/wave2.nkclip.json')
assert r['clip'] == 'wave2' and r['keys'] == app.clips.list()['clips'][0]['keys'], r
s = app.clips.list()
assert [c['name'] for c in s['clips']] == ['wave', 'wave2'] and s['edited'] == 'wave2', s
assert tracks('wave2')[d['clip']['tracks'][0]['joint']][0]['value'] == 0.25
builtins.cl_check([0.0, 0.4, 0.9], clip='wave2')
app.clips.key('elbow', 0.6, -0.9, clip='wave')
r = app.clips.load('${out}/wave.nkclip.json')
s = app.clips.list()
assert [c['name'] for c in s['clips']] == ['wave', 'wave2'] and s['edited'] == 'wave' and app.clips.get('wave') == before, s
with open('${out}/v2.nkclip.json', 'w') as h:
    json.dump({'format': 'nkclip', 'version': 2, 'clip': before}, h)
f('clip.load', 'is not a version 1 clip file', path='${out}/v2.nkclip.json')
d['clip']['tracks'][0]['keys'][0]['interp'] = 'cubic'
with open('${out}/bad.nkclip.json', 'w') as h:
    json.dump(d, h)
f('clip.load', "unknown interpolation 'cubic'", path='${out}/bad.nkclip.json')
f('clip.rename', 'the new name is empty or taken', clip='wave2', to='wave')
assert app.clips.rename('dance', clip='wave2') == {'name': 'dance'}
s = app.clips.set(clip='dance', duration=2.0, loop=True)
assert s['duration'] == 2.0 and s['loop'], s
f('clip.set', 'duration must be above 0 s', clip='dance', duration=-1.0)
s = app.clips.remove('dance')
assert [c['name'] for c in s['clips']] == ['wave'] and s['edited'] == 'wave', s
builtins.cl_before = before

import builtins
s = app.clips.list()
assert [c['name'] for c in s['clips']] == ['wave'] and s['edited'] == 'wave' and not s['can_undo'], s
assert app.clips.get() == builtins.cl_before
builtins.cl_fails('clip.play', 'keys joints the robot lacks')
assert app.clips.remove()['clips'] == []
